title: Application of Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, 94G 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 528, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's Oil Conversation Adjustment charge ti be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings taken in the billing months of July , August and September, 1993. The Oil Conservation Adjustment surcharge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calculation is based on the perspective costs of burning coal and oil.
